name: users.admin.invite
source: first pass -- see methods/*.md and undocumented/INDEX.md for per-method citation

email.desc: Email address of the new user

channels.desc: Comma-separated list of IDs (not names!) for channels, which the new user will auto-join. Both channel IDs for public channels and group IDs for private chanels work.

first_name.desc: Prefilled input for the "First name" field on the "new user registration" page.

last_name.desc: Prefilled input for the "Last name" field on the "new user registration" page.

resend.desc: Resend the invitation email if the user has already been invited and the email was sent some time ago.

restricted.desc: Invite a guest that can use multiple channels

ultra_restricted.desc: Invite a guest that can use one channel only
